name: Gedruk Wingbreaker
description: A Mardu warrior who hacks at a dragon's neck after Jagun holds back.

description_citations.text: "Jagun Wingmate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Instead of killing the dragon, Jagun slashes its foreclaw to protect another fighter, and Gedruk Wingbreaker strikes the neck.
timeline.quote: It was Gedruk Wingbreaker who ran forward and hacked at the creature's neck before it could regain its balance.

citation.text: "Jagun Wingmate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A towering nameless orc stuns a dragon but holds back instead of killing it, and Gedruk Wingbreaker delivers the killing blow.
timeline.quote: It was Gedruk Wingbreaker who ran forward and hacked at the creature's neck before it could regain its balance.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

pages_say.description: An orc warrior who delivers the killing blow to a dragon after another orc holds back.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.
